charge_budget_analysis: rev0 already spends all four INT87 charges in a chain: B startup INT87 converts the dead top b/d tail (+165h); A INT87 captures zom20a (E2F281C3 at +2Bh) at round 10; captured zom20a INT87 captures the live b/d tail (+14Ch); captured b/d INT87 runs the 0E070E17 counter-bomb. Grafting zchain4's order (A+B take the top two b/d tails at rounds 10/12, captured b/d captures zom20a) only permutes these charges. It frees no charge: the counter-bomb moves to the zom20a path, and zom20a is captured about 7 rounds later (round ~17 instead of 10).

recommendation: Do not promote G13 or G13s. Close the card: in rev0 the zombie chain frees no charge, and moving the zom20a capture from A (round 10) to the captured b/d (round ~17) costs about -0.026 vs p0f13 on field S (strong -0.11). Reusable lessons: (1) never use 41 93 E2 F2 as the zom20a patch window (IP-unsafe, and AnotherBit carries it); E2 F2 81 C3 at +2Bh and F2 81 C3 E1 at +2Ch are IP-safe. (2) An independent b/d capture helps against Grindo/callfart, but only if zom20a is still captured early by A, which needs an extra charge that rev0 does not have.
